title: ST558 - Project 1
text:
This project builds a set of generalized queries for accessing and summarizing data from the Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS). PUMS is part of the US Census Bureau’s annual American Community Survey.

Data Source: https://www.census.gov/data/developers/data-sets/census-microdata-api.html
Variables (from 2024): https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs1/pums/variables.html

This project was designed to access the 1-Year PUMS data sets for years 2021 through 2024 only. Additionally, PUMS data for Puerto Rico are not included the scope of this project.

Testing

getPUMSVars()
Expected to fail:

getPUMSVars(2020)  #Invalid year

Error in getPUMSVars(2020): Invalid year input. Function only accepts 2021-2024

getPUMSVars()      #No Year

Error in getPUMSVars(): argument "year" is missing, with no default




getPUMSData()
Expected to work:
Expected to fail:

#Invalid Year
getPUMSData(2020, nums, cats, geo, subgeo)

Error in getPUMSData(2020, nums, cats, geo, subgeo): Invalid year input. Function only accepts 2021-2024.

#Invalid Nums
getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("AGEP", "GASP"))  #too many inputs

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("AGEP", "GASP")): Invalid NUMS input. Only 1 numeric variable in addition to PWGTP may be requested.

getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("PWGTP"))         #too few inputs

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("PWGTP")): Invalid NUMS input. At least 1 numeric variable other than PWGTP must be provided.

getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("STATE"))         #unapproved var

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("STATE")): Invalid NUMS input. The requested variable(s) are not on the approved numeric list.

getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("STATE","PWGTP")) #unapproved var

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("STATE", "PWGTP")): Invalid NUMS input. The requested variable(s) are not on the approved numeric list.

#Invalid Cats
getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("AGEP"), cats=c("SEX","FER"))  #too many inputs

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("AGEP"), cats = c("SEX", "FER")): Invalid CATS input. Only 1 categorical variable may be provided.

getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("AGEP"), cats=c("STATE"))      #unapproved var

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("AGEP"), cats = c("STATE")): Invalid CATS input. The requested variable is not on the approved categorical list.

#Invalid Geo
getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("AGEP"), geo=c("STATE","REGION"))  #too many inputs

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("AGEP"), geo = c("STATE", "REGION")): Invalid GEO input. Only 1 geography variable may be provided.

getPUMSData(2021, nums=c("AGEP"), geo=c("STA"))             #unapproved var

Error in getPUMSData(2021, nums = c("AGEP"), geo = c("STA")): Invalid GEO input. The requested variable is not on the approved geography list.
